The state’s susceptibility to droughts, floods, hurricanes, tornadoes, wildfires, and winter storms threatens the ability to provide clean drinking water to millions of Texans. As climate change exacerbates extreme weather, Texas must adapt its water infrastructure to strengthen resilience. Unique Climate Makes Texas Vulnerable Texas has a highly variable climate with weather extremes. Much of the state is arid or semi-arid, making it vulnerable to drought.
